title: Fun with Reference
content: When I need a model, I set up a mirror and some charcoal paper, and I draw.With a wig and a costume and a scowl, I can be anybody—in my imagination at least.During a break I forget to take off the wig, much to the amusement of FedEx man, who chooses that moment to come by the house.The final painting appears as a gatefold in Nintendo Power magazine to promote the game Dinotopia: Timestone Pirates.(Link for more info.)
